# `network_command`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

Durable outbound provisioning command of one prepaid order item; sent by the billing worker through the network adapter, the item completes only when it is confirmed.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  | Idempotency key sent to the network: derived from the order item and the command kind. |
| `product_order_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `product_order_item_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  |  |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  | activate (add), suspend, restore (resume), deactivate (terminate), change_profile (offering change), swap_sim (the line moves to another SIM or eSIM). |
| `state` | `text` | no | `'pending'::text` | pending (to send, or retried after a temporary error), confirmed, refused (final: the network said no), exhausted (temporary errors used up the automatic attempts; an operator retries), cancelled (the order was cancelled first). |
| `due_date` | `date` | no |  |  |
| `profile` | `jsonb` | no |  | The offering's effective network profile at acceptance, sent unchanged. |
| `request` | `jsonb` | yes |  | The request as first sent (TMF641-shaped, line identifiers resolved); every retry resends it unchanged. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
| `last_error` | `text` | yes |  | The last temporary error, or the network's reason for a refusal. |
| `refusal_code` | `text` | yes |  | The network's refusal code; set only when refused. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `attempted_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
| `confirmed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
